newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH '96 TRADE SURPLUS FIM 44.8 BILLION - CUSTOMS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH '96 TRADE SURPLUS FIM 44.8 BILLION - CUSTOMS.

text.p: to 1.86 billion markka in December from 6.11 billion in November
for a full-year 1996 trade surplus of 44.8 billion, down from
47.5 billion in 1955, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a
The value of exports fell five percent year-on-year in
December while the value of imports rose 15 percent, NCB said.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the December trade
surplus at 1.0 billion markka projecting exports at 15.4 billion
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging
behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined
the European Union at the start of 1995.

December 1996 was the last month that the central bank carried out its own foreign trade survey. NCB and the Bank of Finland will in the future release foreign trade and current account data on the same day starting with the January figures due week 12. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
